children: Watch the Supervive team prepare themselves for battle in this uniquely styled hype-film for TheoryCraft’s debut game.

The first introduction players have to these characters so we wanted to pack in as much personality as we could and in just 30 seconds to do so, the acting needed to pack a punch. We think it turned out pretty great!
